exampleSentence: A pale scar remained on his arm after the accident.
exampleTranslation: 事故之后，他的手臂上留下了一道浅色的伤疤。

exampleSentence: She could scarcely hear the speaker over the noise.
exampleTranslation: 在嘈杂声中，她几乎听不见演讲者的声音。

exampleSentence: The scarcity of clean water forces many families to travel far.
exampleTranslation: 清洁水源短缺迫使许多家庭长途跋涉。

exampleSentence: The sudden noise scared the little girl.
exampleTranslation: 突然的响声吓到了那个小女孩。

exampleSentence: She wore a scarlet coat to the winter party.
exampleTranslation: 她穿了一件鲜红色的外套去参加冬季聚会。

exampleSentence: The farmer scattered seeds across the field before the rain.
exampleTranslation: 下雨前，农夫把种子撒播到田里。

exampleSentence: The team discussed a scenario in which the power fails during the show.
exampleTranslation: 团队讨论了一种演出期间停电的情景。

exampleSentence: The final scene of the film takes place at a railway station.
exampleTranslation: 这部电影的最后一个场景发生在一个火车站。

exampleSentence: The train passes through some beautiful mountain scenery.
exampleTranslation: 火车穿过一片美丽的山间风景。

exampleSentence: The scent of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
exampleTranslation: 新鲜面包的香味充满了厨房。

exampleSentence: The manager checked the weekly schedule before assigning tasks.
exampleTranslation: 经理在分配任务前查看了每周日程表。

exampleSentence: The city introduced a new scheme to reduce traffic.
exampleTranslation: 该市推出了一项减少交通流量的新计划。

exampleSentence: The scholar has studied ancient languages for more than thirty years.
exampleTranslation: 这位学者研究古代语言已经三十多年了。

exampleSentence: She won a scholarship to study abroad next year.
exampleTranslation: 她获得了明年出国留学的奖学金。

exampleSentence: The children walk to school together every morning.
exampleTranslation: 孩子们每天早晨一起步行去学校。

exampleSentence: Modern science helps us understand how the natural world works.
exampleTranslation: 现代科学帮助我们理解自然界如何运作。

exampleSentence: The scientist tested several water samples in the laboratory.
exampleTranslation: 这位科学家在实验室里检测了几份水样。

exampleSentence: Some critics scoffed at the plan before seeing the results.
exampleTranslation: 一些评论者在看到结果之前就嘲笑了这个计划。

exampleSentence: The teacher scolded the boys for running in the hall.
exampleTranslation: 老师因男孩们在走廊里奔跑而责骂了他们。

exampleSentence: The scope of the study was limited to one city.
exampleTranslation: 这项研究的范围仅限于一座城市。

exampleSentence: The iron was too hot and scorched the shirt.
exampleTranslation: 熨斗太热，把衬衫烧焦了。

exampleSentence: Her score on the math test was the highest in the class.
exampleTranslation: 她的数学考试分数是全班最高的。

exampleSentence: She rejected the proposal with scorn.
exampleTranslation: 她轻蔑地拒绝了这个提议。

exampleSentence: The scout moved quietly through the forest at dawn.
exampleTranslation: 侦察员在黎明时分悄悄穿过森林。

exampleSentence: Shoppers scrambled for the discounted goods when the doors opened.
exampleTranslation: 店门一开，顾客们便争抢打折商品。
